scope: Common request/resource/lifetime contracts for token-generation and scoring consumers through Model/Session/Backend. Execution strategies and backend-specific techniques are opt-in.
factory: Static Factory returns a Model through public crit interfaces.
text_frontend: Optional independent host TextFrontend supports concurrent tokenize/detokenize calls during generation. Private TextDecoder instances retain their frontend, validate IDs, and outlive Engine. Legacy model callbacks remain idle-only.
resources: Core owns reservations, budgets and physical lifetimes; consumers declare extents, representations and reuse plans.
requests: Opt-in bounded keyed requests with request/lane-generation identity; serial fallback is preserved.
request_options: Value-owned sampling and stop overrides plus immutable shared host extension parameters. Declared capability checks precede admission; adapters own sampling semantics and private RNG state. Option payload charges and owners survive through retirement or quarantine.
scoring: Declared scoring on ConcurrentModel uses an exclusive FIFO barrier after all earlier generation retirement. Queued scores share allowance/deadlines; active cancellation drains before discarding. Returned score storage stays owned through settlement or quarantine. Public result capacity is reserved separately from adapter-owned scratch.
progress: Readiness precedes copy/charge of borrowed token rows; model commit precedes publication.
group_failure: Poison/quiesce after failed group commit; publish none of that group and preserve earlier committed output.
retirement: Stop producers and drain backends. Retain/quarantine complete owners when settlement is unproved.
streams: When a backend uses asynchronous queues, submit accesses to explicit services and order cross-queue dependencies. CUDA services are optional.
qualification: Source contracts and host references are separate from native/GPU/model/performance acceptance.
transfer_readiness: Order operation-specific worker/copy completion. An earlier completed event or enqueue success cannot publish new content. Retain source and destination owners through actual settlement.

optional_integrations.scope: Expert caching, graph capture and mapped-source resolution are consumer-selected Forge techniques, never core integration requirements. Each selected technique owns its representation-specific correctness contract and optional optimization candidates.

tracing: Optional per-engine bounded host event ring, charged to host resources. Nonblocking writers count loss; snapshots do not acquire model locks or synchronize device work. Request/generation and operation identities correlate phases; host durations and step gaps are diagnostics, not GPU timings. Adapter device_timings() add device point events under the enclosing step operation; a throwing hook counts as dropped trace data.
